title: Add unmount button for manually-mounted network shares that appear in the widget
line: Network shares in Disks & Devices now have an Unmount button, and a Mount action when they are listed in fstab but not mounted.
explanation: Disks & Devices lists network shares (NFS, SMB, sshfs, rclone, from fstab or mounted by hand) but only gave them "Open in File Manager": the mount/unmount actions were limited to removable devices, and the applet didn't even track whether a share was mounted. Also, a hand-mounted share disappears from Solid as soon as it is unmounted, before Solid reports the unmount as finished, and the applet's deferred removal (meant for the "safely removed" message) then kept a spinner on it forever. The change gives network shares the same Mount and Open / Unmount / Mount / Open with File Manager actions as removable devices (labelled "Unmount" instead of "Safely remove"), tracks their mount state, and only defers removal of busy devices that have a removable parent, which is the only case where the message is shown.

commits.message:
applets/devicenotifier: allow unmounting network shares

Network shares in Disks & Devices could only be opened, so a share
mounted from fstab or by hand needed a terminal to unmount. Give them
the Mount and Unmount actions of removable drives and track their state.

BUG: 503714

media.caption: All Devices view: the mounted rclone share only offers Open in File Manager
Same share now shows an Unmount button (and its free space)
Expanding the share shows no actions
Expanded: Unmount plus Open with File Manager, like a USB stick
Share listed in fstab after Unmount: stays in the list, unmounted, with Mount and Open / Mount
A failed mount (rig: setuid mount can't see the test fstab) shows the error, no stuck spinner
Clicking Unmount on a hand-mounted share: it unmounts and leaves the list
